Little lilies lit a still hill in the late light. Jill lifted a thin tin lid and listened. Inside lay a list, a pencil, and a tiny
bell. It was a simple kit, but it invited a small experiment. She drew a line, tilted the lid, and let the bell roll until
it stopped. Then she tried again from a different place. The list grew slowly. Jill did not invent a larger story for
the result. She kept the little details because they might explain why the next trial felt different. Little lilies lit a
